summary: OWNH covers fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. Ownership is concentrated: [O1] holds 54.4%, compared with [O2] at 10.6% and [O3] at 6.5%; blank lines account for 20.5% of lines, and the reported punctuation-only line categories account for 6.4% and 6.3%, all owned by [O1].

Cross-repository authorship is substantial: lines written elsewhere account for 80% in [R1], 78% in [R2] and 66% in [R3]. Ownership by non-contributors ranges from 0% in [R2] to 57% in [R3]; ownership methods agree in no repositories.

At [T0], principal-owner share is 54.3%, up from 51.2% at [T-3], while inactive-owner share is 76.3%, down from 77.9%; both majorities are established. The next blank-line milestone is projected for [T+22], and line survival has a half-life of 2 years.

okr.objective: Improve ownership resilience and measurement consistency across the portfolio.

keyResults.text: Lower principal-owner concentration from the [T0] baseline of 54.3%, which rose from 51.2% at [T-3].
Reduce inactive-owner share from the [T0] baseline of 76.3%; it has eased from 77.9% at [T-3] but remains a majority, held since [T-10].
Increase ownership-method agreement from a baseline of no repositories at [T0].
